description: This Java class implements an import handler for loan data in a microfinance software system. It processes an Excel workbook to import loans, approvals, disbursals, and repayments, converting spreadsheet data into domain objects and issuing platform commands to create and update loans.

classes.name: LoanImportHandler
classes.description: Implements the ImportHandler interface to handle importing loan data from Excel workbook into the system. Converts Excel rows into domain objects, manages import flow, error handling, and issues commands to create and update loan records.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point for processing the Excel workbook; orchestrates reading data and importing entities.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads the loan data, approval data, disbursal data, and repayments from the Excel sheet and populates respective lists.

methods.name: readLoanRepayment
methods.description: Reads a loan repayment record from a row and returns a LoanTransactionData object.

methods.name: readDisbursalData
methods.description: Reads disbursal data from a row and returns a DisbursementData object.

methods.name: readLoanApproval
methods.description: Reads loan approval date from a row and returns a LoanApprovalData object.

methods.name: readLoan
methods.description: Constructs a LoanAccountData object from a sheet row, parsing all required fields and handling special logic for different loan types and charges.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Iterates over the list of imported loan data, performing create/update commands and handling errors; returns a count of success and errors.

methods.name: writeLoanErrorMessage
methods.description: Writes error details to the spreadsheet cells when an import fails at a specific step.

methods.name: setReportHeaders
methods.description: Sets the header row for the import report sheet.

methods.name: importLoanRepayment
methods.description: Creates a command to import a loan repayment transaction into the system.

methods.name: importDisbursalData
methods.description: Creates a disbursal command for disbursing loan funds.

methods.name: importLoanApproval
methods.description: Creates an approval command for a loan application.

methods.name: importLoan
methods.description: Creates a new loan application command with all loan data.

methods.name: getProgressLevel
methods.description: Determines the import progress stage based on loan status.
